chunks: Abu Hamzah al-Thumali narrated from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام that he said:

Whoever performs an obligatory prayer in al-Masjid al-Haram, Allah accepts by means of it from him every prayer he has performed since the day prayer became obligatory upon him, and every prayer he will perform until he dies.

key_terms.وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ: when prayer became obligatory upon him

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing an obligatory prayer in al-Masjid al-Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the immense merit of performing an obligatory salat in al-Masjid al-Haram. It states that such a prayer becomes a cause for Allah to accept all of a person's prayers from the time salat became obligatory upon them until their death.
